### The Door of Opportunity
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/the-door-of-opportunity-one-year-devotions-for-women-december-25.html
Passage: Revelation 3:8
Points:
- Christ offered the church in Philadelphia an open door of opportunity without any words of rebuke.
- Despite having limited human strength, the believers remained obedient and refused to compromise under spiritual opposition.
- Believers today are given similar open doors to witness, serve, and build Christian fellowship.
- Stepping through God's open door does not require great personal might, because Christ provides His power and presence.

### Day 350: Revelation 3:9–13
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-350-revelation-3-913.html
Passage: Revelation 3:9-13
Points:
- The enemy often tries to demoralize faithful Christians into believing their efforts are futile and unloved.
- Christ promised the Philadelphian believers that their detractors would eventually have to acknowledge His deep love for them.
- Overcomers are promised eternal stability, symbolized as pillars in God's temple that cannot be shaken.
- Believers can endure seasons of hardship with confidence by resting securely in Christ's unchanging love and kingdom.
